structuralFindings: Base plan is Full Board (breakfast, lunch, dinner) plus house beverages (water, soft drinks, beer, house wine) — VAT and Catering Levy already included in the quoted rate, no separate mandatory local levy line found on this page.
Three named seasons, not the usual Peak/Shoulder/Green trio: Christmas & New Year (20 Dec - 5 Jan), Premium Season (Jul/Aug/Sep), Regular Season (6 Jan-30 Apr, Jun, Oct, Nov, 1-19 Dec).

Two room types are villa-style priced per person with a 2-6 PAX range (Garden Villa, Residence Villa) and two are room/suite-style capped at 2 PAX (Ocean View Suite, Ocean View Room) — mixed pricing-unit shape within one property, similar in spirit to Soroi Samburu Lodge's per-villa vs per-person split, though here all four categories are still quoted per-person-per-night.
Property is closed 1 May - 10 June 2026 — no rates apply in that window at all.
Two tiers exist for this property: Rack Rates 2026 and Contract Rates 2026 — both single-page PDFs with an identical table layout, Contract consistently lower than Rack across every cell.
